prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Houston after a car wreck. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need a couple quick details so I give you the best, targeted recommendations.

Quick questions
- How serious were your injuries (minor, moderate, catastrophic/permanent)?  
- Do you prefer a large national firm (lots of resources) or a smaller local trial/boutique firm (more individualized attention)?  
- Do you need a Spanish-speaking attorney or other language support?  
- When did the wreck happen and has anyone from an insurance company contacted you?

If you want names right away, I can also give a short list of reputable Houston personal injury firms (with reasons to call each) — but I’ll get more precise if you tell me the points above.

If you’d like immediate next steps while you decide:
- Seek medical care now and keep records of every visit. Medical treatment documents are the most important evidence for injury claims.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to an insurer or sign documents without checking an attorney.  
- Preserve evidence: photos of the scene/vehicle, contact info for witnesses, police report number.  
- Note the date of the wreck — Texas has a two-year statute of limitations for most car-accident injury suits, so don’t delay contacting counsel.

What I’ll do after you reply
- Provide 5–8 specific Houston firms to call, each with a short “why call them” summary (experience, trial record, catastrophic-injury capability, contingency-fee policy, languages, etc.).  
- Give a short phone script and the 7–10 questions to ask each firm on intake to compare them.

Which would you prefer — a tailored list now, or a general list of well-known Houston firms right away?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
